title: C_TTT at the tricritical Ising point via puMPS Koo-Saleur matrix elements: 3.381 +/- 0.005 vs exact 3.3806 -- PASSED
method: Periodic uniform MPS (vendored yijian-physics/puMPS = the Zou-Milsted-Vidal PRL 121 230402 codebase, commit 0557b12) on the O'Brien-Fendley chain at lambda1=1, lambda2=0.428 (= our SIM-051/067 lambda3=0.856 TCI point at half energy normalization). GS via minimize_energy_local_CG! (CG; plain-gradient linesearch thrashes), Bloch excitations at k=0,+2,-2, Koo-Saleur Fourier-mode matrix elements via Hn_in_basis. T identified by ELEMENT DOMINANCE with a Delta-plausibility gate (SIM-067 band-edge discipline); v_T calibrated from Delta_T=2 (exact in any CFT), cross-checked by v_sigma (Delta=3/40) and v_epsilon (Delta=1/5). c = 2|<T|H_{+-2}|0> * N/(2 pi v_T)|^2; C_TTT = 2*sqrt(2)/sqrt(c). Driver: research/tools/pumps-setup/qw_cttt_of.jl (per-round JLD2 checkpointing; results in qw_cttt_of_results.jsonl).

ladder.note: Chirality symmetry holds to <=1e-4 at every N>=20 (largest asymmetry at N=14 where T/L2sigma are near-degenerate). Gap ratio eps/sigma: 2.749 (N=14) -> 2.686 (N=40) -> 2.680 (N=56) vs M(4,5) exact 2.667. v spread at N=56 D=24: v_T=1.6325, v_sigma=1.6200, v_eps=1.6280 (0.8%).

D_systematics: Truncation LOWERS c; the bias grows with N: nil at N=20 (D12==D20 to 1e-4), +0.005 at N=28 (D12->D20), +0.0034 at N=40 (D16->D20), +0.0030 at N=56 (D20->D24). The N=56 D=20 value 0.7008 sat anomalously below the power-law trend (two errors cancelling: finite-N pushes c up, finite-D pushes it down); at D=24 the point lands exactly on the trend. Residual D->inf correction at N=56 estimated <= +0.001-0.002 (geometric decay of the D-shifts) and is included in the systematic band.

fit.model: c(N) = c_inf + a*N^-p, best-D chirality means
fit.quoted: c_inf = 0.699 +/- 0.002 (variant spread + fit error) vs exact 7/10; C_TTT = 3.381 +/- 0.005 vs exact 2*sqrt(2)/sqrt(7/10) = 3.3806

key_findings: The tricritical C_TTT is MEASURED: 3.381 +/- 0.005 vs exact 3.3806 (0.15%-level agreement). Second rung of the stress-tensor self-coupling ladder complete (Ising 3.9936/4.000 in SIM-067; Potts 3.162 remains).

The feared L2eps contamination (~N^-0.2 element mixing, the reason ED could not close TCI at N<=16) is STRONGLY SUPPRESSED in puMPS Bloch-state elements: at N=56 the largest non-T raw element is <=0.0003 vs T's 0.109 (~400x), and the observed finite-size correction exponent is p ~ 2.4, not 0.2. The variational Bloch tower resolves the near-degenerate states that raw ED mixed.

T/L2sigma level ordering flips between N=14 (T = 2nd lowest at k=2) and N>=28 (T = lowest); element-dominance identification handles this automatically -- position-based ID would have silently measured the wrong state.

Two-error cancellation observed and resolved: N=56 D=20 gave a spuriously perfect c=0.7008 (finite-N high bias vs truncation low bias); only the D=24 re-run exposed it. Constant-D ladders or per-N D-convergence checks are mandatory.
operational_notes: Multithreaded BLAS ~3x per CG iteration vs the OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MERAKit discipline (not needed here: CG to unique GS, no basin selection). Warm-starting D by tensor padding throws LAPACKException(30) in the transfer-matrix eigensolve -- the SAME failure as MERAKit's chi-ramp; direct-init at target D confirmed as the rule. Background jobs were externally killed 7 times this run (pairs, ~10-30 min); the working pattern is short CG rounds (15 iters) + per-round checkpoints + wall-clock budget exit(42) + repeated FOREGROUND invocations. CG gradient plateaus at ~9e-5 (linesearch floor); energies are measurement-quality there (quadratic convergence).
verdict: PASSED. C_TTT(TCI) = 3.381 +/- 0.005 vs exact 3.3806. Combined with SIM-067 (Ising 3.9936 vs 4.000), the Koo-Saleur circle route now confirms the stress-tensor self-coupling at TWO universality classes. Next: 3-state Potts (potts3_* builders already in the vendored module), target C_TTT = 2*sqrt(2)/sqrt(4/5) = 3.1623.
